source.stadium_plate: AI-generated fictional stadium plate created for this project
source.player_sprites: AI-generated photographic fictional football player sprite atlas
source.motion: Deterministic synthetic positions and event schedule generated in project code
source.tracking_markers: Enrolled synthetic colour patches composited into the film
source.ball_marker: Enrolled magenta patch inside a rendered white training ball

measurement_boundary: The browser detector receives compressed video pixels, calibration and enrolled marker colours. It does not receive the event schedule or ground-truth coordinates.
limitations: Fixed calibrated camera and controlled synthetic markers
Not face recognition or identity inference on unfamiliar players
Not validated on unfamiliar broadcast footage
Ground-plane speed only; aerial height is not measured
